WITH scan_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    si.healtheval,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
      THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ratio
  FROM scans s
  LEFT JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND s.zoneref IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    healtheval,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scan_data
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
group_means AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  gs.zoneref,
  gs.healtheval,
  gs.avg_ratio,
  gs.scan_count,
  gs.avg_ratio - gm.overall_mean AS beat_amount
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN group_means gm
WHERE gm.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND gs.avg_ratio > gm.overall_mean
ORDER BY beat_amount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
